ai_summary: Brigade Enterprises Limited announced its strategic entry into Coimbatore with a new 5.4-acre residential development through a Joint Development Agreement. This project is estimated to have a Gross Development Value (GDV) of ₹600 Crores, significantly expanding the company's residential portfolio in South India. The move leverages Coimbatore's high-growth potential and represents a positive, standard business expansion with no immediate red flags.
